focus: Spec-kit anatomy: spec docs per level, templates, anchors, contracts, phase-parent shape

findings.claim: Spec packets are NNN-short-name dirs; phase parents keep the lean trio (spec.md, description.json, graph-metadata.json) and carry the Phase Documentation Map

One level contract at templates/spec-kit-docs.json drives levels 1,2,3,3+ and packet types phase/review/research; core docs spec/plan/tasks plus lifecycle implementation-summary; acceptance-criteria optional at L2+; goal durable budget 4000 chars
Templates are anchor-indexed markdown with SPECKIT_TEMPLATE_SOURCE/SPECKIT_LEVEL markers; anchor counts per template 8-42
Anchor grammar is an exact pair with stable lower-kebab ids; ANCHORS_VALID ERROR rule; diagnostics never silently repaired
Canonical frontmatter is five keys (title, description, trigger_phrases, importance_tier, contextType); triggerPhrases alias read-only

openQuestions: Which validator enforces each frontmatter key
research packet shape vs core spec shape
